# Smoothcraft image requests, tier 4: items

831 item textures: what the player holds, drops, wears and sees in the
inventory. The rules in [image-requests.md](image-requests.md) apply: Photoreal, finely detailed base-colour (albedo) map. Flat, even, shadowless lighting: no baked shadows, ambient occlusion, highlights or reflections (Smoothcraft lights every surface itself). Keep the vanilla colours and overall read so the game is still recognisable.
Each is one object on a transparent background, 8x the vanilla size, inside
vanilla's silhouette scaled up: the game extrudes a held item's 3D shape from
its outline. Textures the game tints (leather, potion liquid, dyed layers) stay
light grey. File: `smoothcraft/mod/src/main/resources/resourcepacks/hd/assets/minecraft/textures/<texture>.png`.
